newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Raisio 8-mth profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Raisio 8-mth profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 92 million markka median forecast for foodstuffs and chemicals group Raision Yhtyma Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 15.
In January-August 1995, Raisio posted a 110 million markka profit.

For Raisio's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the 12 analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items, before extraordinaries of 140 million markka (mean 144 million) in a 123-177 million markka range.
The 1995 profit after financial items was 141 million markka.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita and Opstock.
